Service is so bad!!!
Sep 2023 • Friends
Dear team!
I went out to eat a lot, and also ate at Gogi Vincom DN. But I have never been as disappointed as I am today.
The restaurant has ok meat and good food. Our group ordered Mixed Rice and the wait was a bit long (I heard we had to go cook the rice). When it was brought out at the end, the rice underneath was burned, and the onions were burned because they were in the pot. That's what I left out. But from start to finish the restaurant's service was very bad. Sitting down to eat a little without the noise of guests talking, but occasionally hearing the sound of dishes hitting and then falling very loudly (luckily they were made of plastic). What impressed me the most was that the girl brought out the salad plate as a "favor". She didn't even look at the customer. When she saw the table, she tossed the salad plate, then turned around immediately, even though the salad plate was spinning on the table. with very loud sound. We were like "asking questions", not knowing what mood she was in or if we were not happy about ordering that dish. I thought about calling her back but I thought better of it, I think I have the same job as her, which is customer service (I work in tourism). Then next, we called a guy to pay. He must have forgotten to tell us. We sat and waited for a long time until the next table called us to pay and charged us right away. I called again to charge again. I still remained calm, suppressing my anger as much as possible.
When we went out the door, it was raining heavily (before that it had been raining heavily and the wind was strong) but no one had an umbrella to cover the passengers to the car or no one cared about the guests, even the security guard was indifferent. I think the restaurant should equip customers with umbrellas, like we need to cover the motorbike parking space (because our car parking space is not covered), but there are customers who go all the way to the street to board their cars. Some coffee shops can do that
This restaurant should be revisited, because the good news from near, the bad reputation from far away. Hope the shop grows!
